pc.notes: Better Fishing is built in now too -- it sits right beside Tree Chopper under Built-in add-ons. Five craftable rods (Bamboo, Reinforced, Golden Lure, Deep, Abyss); cast at water and you watch a fish swim in, circle your bobber, and bite -- reel in during the bite window or it gets away. Cod, salmon, and a brand-new bass, each in Small, Regular, Large, and Trophy sizes, treasure on any cast, and Fisherman villagers pay emeralds for all twelve special fish. Tree Chopper v3 is unchanged inside. "Check for new mods" knows both are built in.

phone.notes: New built-in add-on: Better Fishing -- find its button right under Tree Chopper. Five craftable rods (Bamboo, Reinforced, Golden Lure, Deep, Abyss); cast at water and you actually watch a fish swim in, circle your bobber, and bite -- use the rod again during the bite window to land it, too slow and it gets away. Cod, salmon, and a brand-new bass, each in Small, Regular, Large, and Trophy sizes (the fish you see is the size you catch), treasure can turn up on any cast, and Fisherman villagers buy all twelve special fish for emeralds. It has its own settings item in-game for the visible fish and bite-window length. Tree Chopper v3 is still inside too, and the app itself works exactly like 1.5.
